rows.title: Each provider from its descriptor
rows.defect: only a provider's first pattern is read, so QUADPAY is missed
rows.test: Klarna, Affirm, Afterpay, Zip (and Quadpay), PayPal Pay in 4

rows.title: The store only when the descriptor carries it
rows.defect: a generic word after "*" is taken as the store
rows.test: KLARNA*TARGET is Target; AFFIRM *PAY names no store

rows.title: Look-alikes are not payments
rows.defect: word boundaries are dropped from the patterns
rows.test: AFFIRMATIVE INSURANCE, ZIPCAR, ZIPRECRUITER, PAYPAL INST XFER

rows.title: Plans of different amounts stay apart
rows.defect: plans are grouped without their amount
rows.test: a $40.00 plan and a new $60.00 plan from Klarna on the same day

rows.title: Every 2 weeks, not every week
rows.defect: payments a week apart are chained as one plan
rows.test: two $25.00 Afterpay plans a week apart

rows.title: What's left, not the whole plan
rows.defect: the plan's whole amount is said as still owed
rows.test: 3 of 4 seen is $40.00 left

rows.title: "Up to" when the first payment is not in the rows
rows.defect: a plan whose start is not in the rows is counted as if it were
rows.test: rows from Sep 28 give up to 2 payments, up to $80.00

rows.title: An earlier payment from the provider makes the start uncertain
rows.defect: a payment two weeks before the chain is ignored
rows.test: a $55.00 Klarna payment on Sep 14 before $40.00 on Sep 28 and Oct 12

rows.title: A monthly plan is read, its total never guessed
rows.defect: monthly payments are never chained into a plan
rows.test: Affirm $62.18 a month, next Nov 3, still owed not in the rows

rows.title: Zip's first payment with a fee joins its plan
rows.defect: a different first payment is left out of the plan
rows.test: $26.50, then $25.00 twice: 3 of 4 seen, $25.00 left

rows.title: A refund equal to what was paid closes the plan
rows.defect: a matching refund is never applied
rows.test: Best Buy $100.00 back after 2 payments of $50.00

rows.title: Money back is never a payment
rows.defect: a credit from the provider is read as a payment
rows.test: a $15.00 credit from Klarna

rows.title: Pending said, not counted
rows.defect: a pending payment is counted as made
rows.test: a pending $20.00 Afterpay payment

rows.title: Other currencies never added
rows.defect: a EUR payment is read as dollars
rows.test: 25.00 EUR Klarna payments

rows.title: The person's day
rows.defect: today is read in UTC
rows.test: 11:30 p.m. Oct 12 in New York: next expected today

rows.title: The bank's tomorrow is this evening
rows.defect: a row dated tomorrow is left out
rows.test: a payment dated Oct 13 counts on Oct 12 in New York

rows.title: A finished plan owes nothing
rows.defect: a plan with all 4 payments stays in progress
rows.test: Afterpay 4 of 4 paid is listed as finished

rows.title: Item 87 counts the pay-later payments
rows.defect: the pay-later payments are left out of the projection

rows.title: Item 87 never counts a plan twice
rows.defect: a plan's payments are also projected as a repeating bill
rows.test: Klarna payments are not also a repeating bill

rows.title: A new plan on the provider's terms
rows.defect: a new plan is laid out every week
rows.test: $400.00 Afterpay: 4 payments of $100.00 every 2 weeks from today

rows.title: The newest plan with and without
rows.defect: the newest plan is never taken out
rows.test: -$80.00 on Nov 9 with it, $120.00 on Nov 1 without

rows.title: No cash, no number
rows.defect: a projection is made from $0.00
rows.test: only a credit card linked

rows.title: The list asks
rows.defect: list asks are never recognized
rows.test: "bnpl", "what do I owe klarna", "my afterpay payments" and three more

rows.title: Paying, paying off, moving a date and advice go on
rows.defect: advice and money-movement asks are answered
rows.test: "should i use a $400 klarna plan or will it push me negative"

rows.title: Source and as-of
rows.defect: the source line is dropped
rows.test: the last line names the rows and their as-of time

rows.title: Not built is said
rows.defect: the not-built line is dropped
rows.test: paying, paying off early and moving a date are not built

rows.title: Stale provider terms are said
rows.defect: terms past their window are never flagged
rows.test: terms checked Jan 2, 2026 may have changed

rows.title: One provider named narrows it
rows.defect: every provider is listed whatever was asked
rows.test: "my afterpay payments" lists Afterpay only

rows.title: A missing payment makes what's left uncertain
rows.defect: a plan whose payment never came is still counted as certain
rows.test: Sep 21 expected and not in the rows
